sourceQuery:
SELECT
        p.id,
        p.sku,
        p."internalBarcode",
        p.brand,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.subcategory,
        p."shortDescription",
        p."longDescription",
        p.features,
        p."aiContext",
        p."imageUrl",
        p."updatedAt"
      FROM "Product" p
      WHERE p.active = true
        AND p.price > 0
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "ProductSize" ps
          JOIN "StoreStock" ss ON ss."productSizeId" = ps.id
          WHERE ps."productId" = p.id AND ss.stock > 0
        )
      ORDER BY p.brand, p.name, p.id
